drive_parameters.actuator_model: native motor T0*(u-sign(u)*bk) on input-latched sliding branch; zero source torque on stick branch
drive_parameters.roller_geometry: unmodified FUJI barrel mesh; uniform 65/205 scale; MasterPi 9 rollers
drive_parameters.wheel_mass: legacy 50g; FUJI hub:roller mass proportions at 9 rollers

public_model.contact_model: URDF mesh collision; MuJoCo convex hull port with condim 3
public_model.source_self_collide: SDF model default false; equivalent wheel assembly exclusions in port

drive_parameters.self_collision: roller versus own robot excluded, matching source assembly self_collide=false
drive_parameters.zero_command: input relay resets; passive DC speed loss remains
drive_parameters.state_scope: per-wheel command sign/history only; not measured motion or policy observation
drive_parameters.reset_rule: world.reset clears all input relay states before normal scene reset
drive_parameters.friction_model: input hysteresis replaces wheel joint dry loss; roller contact/bearing unchanged
drive_parameters.start_source: user observation <=30 rest >=35 sustained; midpoint32.5 fixed before v6
drive_parameters.kinetic_source: Hiwonder encoder TT I0=.1A Is=1.2A; Tc/T0=I0/Is conditional all no-load loss Coulomb
drive_parameters.diagnostic_scope: v6 stall contact normal torque is external geometry/load resistance; not subtracted from motor I0/Is
drive_parameters.implementation_source: MathWorks Relay on/off hysteresis; Karnopp stick/slip principle adapted to user-requested input state
